policy.source_change: All construction is controlled. Retired 70/15/10/5 generation-source quotas are not enforced. The 1400-depth/600-semantic per-query strata are retained as evidence cohorts, not source labels. All numerical depth, Count-value, family and evidence minima are unchanged.
policy.which_cohorts: Depth cohort: 900 A-D + 200 F + 300 multiple-entailment E. Semantic cohort: 300 A-D + 225 no-entailed E + 75 inconsistent E. Extra positive support in the semantic cohort receives no depth-stratum credit.

selection_rule: First nonoverlapping canonical questions in each fixed quota group; at most three predeclared candidates per slot; no refill.
